integrity: Group-scheme claim follows from functorial coefficient comparison over nonreduced coefficient rings. Symbolic and finite-field checks supplement but do not establish the universal assertion.
scientific_limitations: Computes the scheme-theoretic projective stabilizer of the fixed embedded characteristic-two quartic, not abstract automorphisms or all pencil members; unindexed earlier group-scheme calculations may exist.
title: The non-smooth projective stabilizer scheme of a characteristic-two rational quartic
